description: This PHP class defines the UserAuthProvider entity for a Human Resource Management system, including ORM mappings, properties for user authentication types, LDAP attributes, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Entity class representing a user authentication provider with fields for ID, user relation, provider type, and LDAP details, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user authentication provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user authentication provider.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this authentication provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type (local or LDAP).

methods.name: getLDAPUserHash
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP user hash if available.

methods.name: getLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: setLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP user's unique identifier.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user's unique identifier.
